raw_sections.Description:
The HP Victus Gaming Laptop 16-R1011NIA A7KC2EABH5 features an Intel Core i7-14700HX processor with 20 cores and 28 threads, paired with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 6GB GDDR6 graphics card. It includes 16GB DDR5-SDRAM at 5600 MHz and a 512GB PCIe Gen4 NVMe M.2 SSD. The 16.1-inch Full HD IPS display offers a 1920 x 1080 resolution, 144Hz refresh rate, 300 cd/m² brightness, and NVIDIA G-SYNC support. Additional specifications include Intel Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, HDMI 2.1, a backlit full-size English keyboard with numeric keypad, a 70 Wh battery, and FreeDOS. Explore the HP Victus 16-R1011NIA gaming laptop specifications at Compumarts Egypt.
